a.lede: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.
a.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity

b.lede: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
b.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
